tips: Hit the Limousine Bus ticket counter before immigration; lines back up fast when multiple international flights land.
Add Suica to Apple/Google Wallet while waiting at MSP or on the plane — land with transit ready.

suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Rain plan: Miyashita Park covered rooftop + Parco + Tower Records (9 floors) absorb a full wet afternoon without surfacing.

tips: Shibuya Sky tickets sell out days in advance — book the sunset slot online now if you haven't.
If the jet-lag wall hits hard, swap the late Blue Cave walk for an early nomihodai and crash by 23:00.

Skytree night queues can top 90 minutes; if the line is insane, detour to Asahi Beer Hall's 22F Sky Room for the same river view with a beer in hand.

2026-12-19.weatherAlert: High rain risk for a coastal day trip. The Enoshima island climb and Fuji-over-the-bay sunset view are heavily weather-dependent.

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: Enoshima island — climb to the Sea Candle
suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Enoshima onsen finish: Enospa overlooks the bay — soak with a Fuji view before the train if legs are cooked.

The Enoden coastal tram gets packed on winter weekends; grab a window seat early.
Ghibli Museum tickets are strictly timed and sell out instantly; have screenshots ready and arrive 10 mins early.
Run the Airbnb washer during dinner so everyone lands in Kyoto with clean clothes.

2026-12-21.weatherAlert: Rain risk in the afternoon. Gion's golden hour walk and Shirakawa canal strolls lose their charm in heavy downpours.
tips: If it pours, duck into the Kyoto International Manga Museum for hours of dry, indoor entertainment.
Nintendo Kyoto (Takashimaya) is 5 min from Nishiki — scout today, buy in Osaka to avoid carrying boxes on the train.

2026-12-22.weatherAlert: Rain risk in the afternoon. The Kiyomizu-dera wooden stage and Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka descent are steep, uncovered, and slippery when wet.

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: Kiyomizu-dera — the wooden stage over the valley
suggestedSwap.suggestedAlt: Rain plan: Sanjusangendo — 1,001 golden Kannon statues in a 120m hall. Indoor, jaw-dropping, criminally underrated.
suggestedSwap.reason: The steep walk up to Kiyomizu-dera and the wooden stage offer zero cover and become hazardous in the rain; Sanjusangendo is entirely indoors and stunning.

tips: Fushimi Inari at dawn is the move — by 09:00 the main gate is packed, so start the hike no later than 06:45.
Funaoka Onsen's electric bath is a wild tingle; limit your first dip to a few seconds!

suggestedSwap.originalActivity: Iwatayama Monkey Park — humans enter the cage

Bow to the deer before offering crackers, and show empty hands when done so they don't nip you.

tips: If you haven't pre-ordered KFC, pivot to a convenience store fried chicken bucket — it's equally festive and zero wait.
Buy Rikuro's jiggly cheesecake near Namba station early in the day; they sell out by evening.

tips: If Express Passes sold out, use single-rider lines — Mario Kart cuts 60% off the wait time.

2026-12-26.weatherAlert: Rain risk for Miyajima. The floating torii gate is best at low tide, and the ferry/island walk is fully exposed.
tips: Check the Miyajima tide charts in the morning — the torii 'floating' effect requires high tide, which doesn't always align with afternoon arrival.
This is the longest day of the trip; if anyone is redlining, skip Miyajima, do the Peace Museum unhurried, and meet at Hiroshima station.

2026-12-27.weatherAlert: Rain risk for the Midosuji Illumination walk. Walking 4km of lit boulevard is grim in a downpour.
tips: If it pours, swap the Midosuji walk for the Osaka Museum of Housing & Living (life-size Edo street indoors).
Buy 551 Horai butaman from Namba station BEFORE the crab dinner — they sell out nightly and make the best next-morning breakfast.
Himeji Castle involves steep, narrow climbs — wear good shoes and brace for cold winds at the top.
Do a tax-free paperwork check tonight: ensure receipts are with passports and purchases are accessible for customs on exit.
Zero out your Suica cards by buying a final konbini haul or last gachapon; you can't easily refund the balance.
Japanese whisky (Hibiki/Yamazaki) at HND duty-free often beats US prices badly — buy AFTER security and keep it sealed for the flight.

globalTips: With the USD/JPY rate at ~161.68, Japan is highly affordable right now. Withdraw large sums of cash from 7-Eleven ATMs for the best exchange rates, as many smaller eateries and bars in Golden Gai/Ura-Namba are cash-only.

December in Japan is cold and dry, but rain is possible. Pack a lightweight, packable rain shell and comfortable, water-resistant walking shoes — you'll easily clock 15-20k steps a day on mostly outdoor pavement.
For a group of 8, always split into two squads of 4 for restaurants, bars, and small shops — Japanese establishments rarely seat octets together, and splitting up drastically reduces wait times.
